game_title: Function Test Arena – Aurora Terrace Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing snow wraiths. Each round, a new warm lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 490 points of warm lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 490, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 490 within 41 seconds.
